links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM treatment recommendations across 4 repeated identical queries
links.effect: Stability differed significantly across models (P=.01). Gemini 3 Pro discordance 12.8% (Fleiss κ=0.737); GPT-4o discordance 30.2% (Fleiss κ=0.430). Complete discordance in 17 of 107 (15.9%) cases.
links.quote: Gemini 3 Pro showed the lowest discordance rate (mean 12.8%, SD 2.3%) and the highest reference-free agreement (Fleiss κ=0.737), whereas GPT-4o showed the highest discordance rate (mean 30.2%, SD 6.5%) and the lowest agreement (Fleiss κ=0.430).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the stability and concordance of multiple commercial LLMs on retrospective multidisciplinary team oncology cases, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
